xda.author: XDA Deals Desk
xda.body:
The SwitchBot Smart Lock Ultra with Keypad is at its all-time low of $125.99
Smart locks with fingerprint readers have been a mid-price premium tier for a while, and most of the options in that range either skip the keypad, skip the app, or require a hub that adds another $30 to the bill.

xda.author: Yash Patel
xda.body:
I vibe-coded my own productivity tools to replace the software I used every day
I've always found it frustrating when a software tool almost fits my needs but misses a few things that matter to my workflow. Adding another subscription or switching between multiple apps isn't always the answer. With AI coding assistants, there's now another option: building the tools myself. I experimented with this approach and created a handful of small applications and browser extensions to handle everyday tasks using Claude Code (Opus 5.5). Some turned out more useful than I expected.

xda.author: Ayush Pande
xda.body:
Home Assistant now has a built-in store for community integrations, and these are the 4 I'd install first
Although Home Assistant is already loaded with all sorts of cool features, the Open Home Foundation keeps releasing monthly updates to bolster its functionality even further. The March 2026 update, for example, brought voice satellite support to the HASS Companion app on phones, making it a lot easier to build locally-hosted voice-controlled assistants. Likewise, the August update enhanced Home Assistant’s LLM conversation elements, while the April 2026 release brought native infrared support and IR proxies to the platform.
